entities.summary: The Mehmet Agha Mosque is a former mosque, located on Sokratous street within the old walled town of Rhodes, on the eponymous island, in the South Aegean region of southern Greece. Built in 1819 during the Ottoman era, the mosque was abandoned, most likely in the 1940s, and it is not open for worship.
